findings.evidence: Positivity.lean:155 `private lemma one_le_sqrt_one_add_targetMass (M x : ℝ) {Q2 : ℝ} (hQ2 : 0 ≤ Q2) : 1 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + 4 * M ^ 2 * x ^ 2 / Q2)`; Longitudinal.lean:172 `def FLExact (M x Q2 F1 F2 : ℝ) : ℝ := (1 + 4 * M ^ 2 * x ^ 2 / Q2) * F2 - 2 * x * F1`.
findings.fix: Make it public and put it with the target-mass factor it is about — next to `FLExact` in `Tensors/Longitudinal.lean`, which is the file that owns the raw-real `1 + 4 M² x² / Q²` — and use it from here.
findings.issue: `private lemma one_le_sqrt_one_add_targetMass` is general infrastructure: its statement mentions only `ℝ`/`Real.sqrt` and its proof (`Real.one_le_sqrt` + `positivity`) is independent of helicity matrices. Hiding it means any consumer converting the sharp bound `sqrt_mul_abs_F3_le_two_mul_F1` into a γ-free one (e.g. the Layer 2 corollary `|x F₃| ≤ F₂`) must reprove it.

findings.evidence: Positivity.lean:121-123 states it only for `H : HelicityMatrix`, used once at line 227. Mathematics/DataStructures/Matrix/PosSemidef.lean:23-25: "the arithmetic-mean form of the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality `(M i j) ^ 2 ≤ M i i * M j j`" — the geometric-mean form is named there but absent; roadmap convention 9 points the Layer 1 bounds at that module.
findings.fix: State it generally as `Matrix.PosSemidef.sq_apply_le {M : Matrix n n ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) (i j) : M i j ^ 2 ≤ M i i * M j j` in `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/DataStructures/Matrix/PosSemidef.lean` (same one-line `simpa … using hM.normSq_le i j` proof), drop the HelicityMatrix wrapper, and call `H.posSemidef.sq_apply_le idxPlus idxMinus` in `sq_apply_plus_minus_le`.
findings.issue: `HelicityMatrix.sq_apply_le` is the geometric-mean Cauchy–Schwarz bound for an arbitrary real positive-semidefinite matrix, but is confined to this file's bundled type, so no other PSD matrix in the repo (e.g. `PDF.Positivity.SpinDensity`, which needs exactly this for a geometric-mean Soffer form) can use it. The repo's PSD module already advertises this inequality and supplies only the arithmetic-mean form.

findings.evidence: Positivity.lean:164-167 `lemma F1_eq ... F1 = (H.mat idxPlus idxPlus + H.mat idxMinus idxMinus) / 2`; no `F3`-side lemma exists in the file (only the bound `sqrt_mul_abs_F3_le_two_mul_F1` at line 179).
findings.fix: Add the parallel elimination lemma `sqrt_mul_F3_eq (h : IsHelicityMatrixOf H M x Q2 F1 F2 F3) : Real.sqrt (1 + 4 * M ^ 2 * x ^ 2 / Q2) * F3 = H.mat idxMinus idxMinus - H.mat idxPlus idxPlus` (one `linarith` from `h.plus`, `h.minus`), and, with the lemma of finding 1 public, an `F3_eq` under `0 ≤ Q2`.
findings.issue: `F1_eq` recovers `F₁` from the diagonal entries but there is no counterpart recovering `F₃`, so a consumer who obtains a helicity matrix (e.g. from `forall_apply_self_nonneg_iff_exists_isHelicityMatrixOf`) cannot read off `F₃` without unfolding both fields and reproving `0 < √(1 + γ²)` — the very fact kept private at line 155.

summary: The surface is minimal, bodies are unexposed and there is no compatibility layer, but two generally-applicable results are locked to this file (a private `1 ≤ √(1+γ²)` and a real-PSD Cauchy–Schwarz stated only on `HelicityMatrix`), and the `F₁` recovery lemma has no `F₃` counterpart.
